{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABepGwMA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhIKVLs", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 353, "title": "Simplify Models cards to one Details disclosure; consolidate attribution into License & source", "body": "## Goal

Make each model card on the **Models** page compact and easy to scan. Today **Verified files and size**, **License & source**, and **Attribution & notices** appear as separate items, sometimes alongside long text. Consolidate nonessential metadata into **one collapsed Details disclosure** and remove the separate **Attribution & notices** control.

The normal card view should focus on **model name, cache/readiness state, short size/purpose metadata, download progress when applicable, and the appropriate Download / Retry / Cancel / Delete action**.

## Current implementation

In [`extension/model-cache.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/model-cache.js), `ModelCard` currently creates:

- `<details><summary>Verified files and size</summary>` with verified byte counts and a file list;
- a `model-license` block with `definition.linkLabel || 'Source'` pointing to `definition.url`, plus optional `definition.links`;
- a second nested `<details><summary>Attribution & notices</summary>` containing the long `definition.terms` text;
- special TranslateGemma terms also shown before download.

These separate controls make each card look cluttered.

## Requested UI

1. Render **one** disclosure per card labeled simply **Details**, **collapsed by default**.
2. Within expanded Details, show:
   - verified files, bytes and cache information (currently under **Verified files and size**), clearly labeled but **without another nested disclosure**;
   - a concise, descriptive **License & source** / **License / terms** / **Source** link as appropriate, with any additional legally needed source/notice links.
3. Remove the independent **Verified files and size** disclosure (merge its contents into Details), the separate **Attribution & notices** disclosure, and redundant visible attribution paragraphs/duplicate links. Do **not** replace them with a new generic information banner or extra top-level prose.
4. **Consolidate required attribution and notices into the resources reached via License & source**, checking that the actual destinations provide required author/attribution, licenses, terms, notices, redistributor/source obligations and relevant conversion provenance. If an existing target does not include required information, update the linked notice document or provide the correct compact legal/source links. Do not silently drop obligations just because their previously inline `definition.terms` copy is removed.
5. Keep legally material **before-download** model-specific terms accessible at the point of use. In particular, retain the necessary TranslateGemma/Gemma usage restrictions and links **before** downloading, without recreating a page-wide warning or unrelated clutter. The normal collapsed Details approach may be supplemented by a short model-specific notice only when genuinely needed for compliance.
6. Preserve special additional links (e.g. Kokoro/eSpeak NG source/build bundle) and voice/variant-specific notices where relevant. Use accurate link labels: never call an upstream source page a license document unless it actually contains license terms.
7. **No new explanatory helper text** justifying the UI or describing routine operations. Hide metadata by default; use in-context actionable error messages only when there is a real failure.

## Keep all model functionality

- Preserve the real `ModelAssetCache` file integrity verification, cached/total byte accounting, file list, status/progress, downloads/retries/cancellation, cache deletion, variant selection and cross-tab status updates.
- Do not reintroduce **Check cache** [#329](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/329), or a Download button in the **Ready** state [#330](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/330).
- Make the one Details control accessible by mouse/touch/keyboard with sensible focus and layout in both desktop and narrow cards.
- Prefer the current source metadata/document URLs; add necessary notice documents only when existing sources are insufficient, not to invent more UI sections.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every model card has **one collapsed Details disclosure**, with no independent **Verified files and size** or **Attribution & notices** controls.
- [ ] When collapsed, the card shows only its normal useful name/state/brief metadata/actions; legal/source text and file inventories do not clutter it.
- [ ] Expanding Details shows correct verified file/size information and concise, working legal/source links without nested details toggles.
- [ ] Relevant license/terms/source/attribution information remains available and legally required notices are not dropped; extra eSpeak/Kokoro/TTS links remain reachable.
- [ ] TranslateGemma-specific required pre-download legal information remains appropriately disclosed, without a separate global warning footer.
- [ ] Downloading, verification, Ready, error, retry, deleting and voice-variant state changes still behave correctly.
- [ ] Desktop/mobile layouts and automated UI, keyboard/accessibility and license-link checks pass.

## Likely files

- `extension/model-cache.js`: restructure `ModelCard` details/license/notice rendering and reuse of `definition.terms`, `definition.url` and optional `definition.links`.
- `extension/models.css`: layout/spacing changes and obsolete styling.
- `web/licenses/`, `web/third-party-notices.txt` and any existing linked notices **only if needed** to make required information available from the consolidated links.
- Relevant extension Models UI tests and any documentation/screenshots.

## Related work

- [#332](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/332) introduced short License & source links; keep them concise.
- [#335](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/335) moved TranslateGemma terms away from a standalone footer; do not regress that.
- [#324](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/324) and [#349](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/349) established the minimalist Models page design. **Avoid new permanent explanatory UI text.**

This is a presentation and legal-information consolidation task, **not** a change to model downloads, inference, or licenses themselves.
